params.caption: 🎮 Duolingo's Duo is heading into Pokémon Go Duo, the famously persistent green owl from the Duolingo app, is set to show up in Pokémon Go, IGN reports. The mascot is leaving your lock screen behind for a crossover appearance in the mobile AR hit, the latest game collab for the owl after Brawl Stars and Genshin Impact. 🕒 Nov 17, 2026 · 04:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: IGN 👥 @PokemonGoApp · @Pokemon 🦉 React if Duo got you too · 💬 Would you catch him or run? #PokemonGo #Duolingo #Pokemon #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
